# Local OCR assets

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 from the development runtime, with their license notices.
Language models: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 and @tesseract.js-data/por 1.0.0, variant 4.0.0_best_int, installed from registry.npmjs.org with npm integrity verification. Original package metadata retained in lang/.
Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js ; https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core ; https://github.com/naptha/tessdata .
No CDN is used at runtime. SHA256SUMS lists the distributed asset bytes.
